results.title: Carter Country
results.overview: Carter Country is a feature-length documentary that chronicles the extraordinary two-year journey of Jimmy Carter, America’s most unlikely presidential candidate, and the small Georgia town that stood behind him every step of the way. Through the lens of Plains, Georgia, a community of just 700 residents, the film captures the forgotten spirit of 1976, a pivotal moment when a humble Southern town unexpectedly became the political capital of the world during one of the most remarkable presidential campaigns in American history.  Featuring a voice cast of more than 40 performers, many of whom are Plains residents and members of the Carter family portraying their own historic relatives, the film offers an authentic and deeply personal perspective.

results.title: A Trout and the Last Waltz
results.original_title: サクラマスのラストワルツ
results.overview: Born in rivers, yamame trout journey to the sea and return as cherry salmon, connecting forests, rivers, and coastal communities. This documentary explores how dams, abandoned forests, and renewable energy development have disrupted these natural cycles, examining what economic progress has cost the environment and the cultures shaped by it.

results.title: Mono No Aware
results.overview: "Mono No Aware" is a short film shot on Super 8 film that creates a brief visual poem expressing the Japanese aesthetic concept of the sweet melancholy we feel in the presence of the beauty of things, precisely because we know they will not last forever.

results.title: ORDINARY EXCELLENCE: The Story of Grant Fisher
results.original_title: ORDINARY EXCELLENCE: The Story of Grant Fisher
results.overview: Excellence is built through thousands of ordinary moments.  Coming off a historic performance at the Paris Olympics, where he became the first American male to medal in both the 5,000m and 10,000m at the same Games, Grant Fisher has helped usher in a new era of American distance running.  Ordinary Excellence follows Fisher as he prepares for his half marathon debut, offering an intimate look at the discipline and consistency behind one of the world's greatest distance runners.  Our hope is to tell stories that offer a new perspective on running and contribute something meaningful to the sport.  Made independently by Minted New York, with the support of a community that allows us to create beyond clothing.  Thank you for making this possible.

results.title: Close
results.overview: Keane finds a box of his absent father’s negatives. He prints the images in a darkroom’s red glow. As he and his mother Diane look through distant exposures from the half-past, the prints expose a life that was always out of frame. Closure leads them back to the shoreline, where Keane reframes what remains.
